most_similar_reason: Candidate 2 is the only story centered on a religion founded by a wandering human teacher and on royal figures renouncing their throne to live as solitary ascetics, closely echoing the target's prince-turned-mendicant founder of a monastic faith.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 4 concerns an ancestral/creator deity who makes humans and livestock from reeds and then forgets and abandons his creation, with no teacher, no teachings, no disciples, and no renunciation or awakening at all.
